summary: Trial Extension and Tier Change Features - All tests passed. Backend APIs (12/12 tests) and Frontend UI verified working correctly.

trial_extension_api.details: POST /api/admin/organizations/{org_id}/extend-trial correctly accepts {days: N} and returns new_trial_end, days_remaining, message, org_id

trial_extension_validation.details: API correctly rejects invalid days (0, negative, missing) with 400 status

trial_extension_auth.details: API correctly requires admin authentication (401 for unauthenticated)

tier_change_api.details: PUT /api/admin/organizations/{org_id}/tier correctly updates tier and returns stripe_updated, stripe_error fields

tier_change_demo_org.details: Demo orgs (sub_demo_ prefix) correctly skip Stripe updates - stripe_updated=false, stripe_error=null

tier_change_validation.details: API correctly rejects invalid tier_id and missing tier_id with 400 status

admin_org_list_trial_fields.details: GET /api/admin/organizations includes is_trial, trial_end_date, subscription_status fields

frontend_trial_badge.details: Trial orgs show 'Trial: X days left' badge with end date

frontend_extend_trial_button.details: Clicking 'Extend Trial' reveals days input and confirm/cancel buttons

frontend_extend_trial_flow.details: Confirming trial extension calls API, shows success toast, and refreshes org card with updated trial info

frontend_grant_trial_extension.details: Non-trial orgs show 'Grant Trial Extension' button that reveals 'Start trial for X days' form

frontend_tier_dropdown.details: Tier dropdown shows all tier options (Individual Coach, Coach Developer, Club, legacy tiers) and changes tier on selection

critical_code_review_comments: Trial extension and tier change implementations are well-structured with proper validation
MongoDB projection on line 2555 correctly includes trial-related fields (is_trial, trial_end_date, subscription_status)
Stripe sync correctly filters out demo (sub_demo_) and trial (sub_trial_) subscription IDs
Frontend handleExtendTrial correctly calls loadData() to refresh org list after extension
